description: Splits a signal into sixteen frequency bands, each with its own level knob and jack, and adds them back together in eights, fours, halves and one sum

params.text: Sets the level of the band from below 50Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from 50Hz to 75Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from 75Hz to 110Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from 110Hz to 160Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from 160Hz to 235Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from 235Hz to 345Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from 345Hz to 500Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from 500Hz to 730Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from 730Hz to 1000Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from 1000Hz to 1500Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from 1500Hz to 2200Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from 2200Hz to 3300Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from 3300Hz to 4800Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from 4800Hz to 7100Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from 7100Hz to 10000Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs
Sets the level of the band from above 10000Hz, 0 to 2, before that band reaches any of the outputs

inputs.text: The signal to be split, one per channel

outputs.text: The part of the signal from below 50Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from 50Hz to 75Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from 75Hz to 110Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from 110Hz to 160Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from 160Hz to 235Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from 235Hz to 345Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from 345Hz to 500Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from 500Hz to 730Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from 730Hz to 1000Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from 1000Hz to 1500Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from 1500Hz to 2200Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from 2200Hz to 3300Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from 3300Hz to 4800Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from 4800Hz to 7100Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from 7100Hz to 10000Hz, at the level set by its knob
The part of the signal from above 10000Hz, at the level set by its knob
The two bands covering below 75Hz added together, each at the level set by its knob
The two bands covering 75Hz to 160Hz added together, each at the level set by its knob
The two bands covering 160Hz to 345Hz added together, each at the level set by its knob
The two bands covering 345Hz to 730Hz added together, each at the level set by its knob
The two bands covering 730Hz to 1500Hz added together, each at the level set by its knob
The two bands covering 1500Hz to 3300Hz added together, each at the level set by its knob
The two bands covering 3300Hz to 7100Hz added together, each at the level set by its knob
The two bands covering above 7100Hz added together, each at the level set by its knob
The four bands covering below 160Hz added together, each at the level set by its knob
The four bands covering 160Hz to 730Hz added together, each at the level set by its knob
The four bands covering 730Hz to 3300Hz added together, each at the level set by its knob
The four bands covering above 3300Hz added together, each at the level set by its knob
The eight bands below 730Hz added together, each at the level set by its knob
The eight bands above 730Hz added together, each at the level set by its knob
All sixteen bands added back together; with every knob at 1 this is the signal at IN again

notes: nothing is computed and no output is written until a cable is patched into IN
the splitting is done by eighth order crossovers in a tree, so a band and its neighbours add back to the signal without a dip at the crossover
